channel.title: SIREN — index moves
channel.description: Every AI doom number is a judgement call. This one is arithmetic: how much is happening in AI, measured hourly from public data — not how bad it is. Five pillars, one 0-100 score, one level from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest), and every number reproducible from a published receipt.

item.title: SIREN 4 · 56.1 (+2.5)
item.description: Score 53.6 to 56.1 (+2.5) at 2026-11-14 14:54:23 UTC. SIREN measures how much is happening, not how bad it is. Levels run from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest) and describe observable activity tempo against this index’s own record. They are not a probability of harm.
